title: How to Build an E-Commerce App with AI (No Shopify Required)
summary: Build a custom e-commerce app — product catalog, cart, Stripe checkout, user accounts, order management — without a developer or a Shopify subscription.
body_markdown: Blink is free to start — no credit card required. Shopify starts at $29/month (Basic) plus 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction through third-party processors. On a store doing $10,000/month in sales, Shopify Basic costs roughly $319/month in fees alone (platform + transaction). Blink doesn't take a cut of your transactions. Your only payment processing cost is Stripe's standard rate.
